evidence: M-O s.v. Christian: Annunciation: diēs annūntiātae Virginī fēstīvus (Ducrue, 1784)
terms.comment: An announcing (late and Church Latin, Lewis & Short); the feast of 25 March in both churches. The Greek name, Εὐαγγελισμός, means the good news.

phrases.latin: Avē grātiā plēna: Dominus tēcum: benedicta tū in mulieribus.
phrases.english: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you: blessed are you among women.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. Christian: Annunciation.
